propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state that the close precheck requires a MERGED rebar-ticket commit, when the implementation scans HEAD's entire reachable history regardless of merge status
The close precheck is conditional on recorded file_impact and the require_completion_verification_for_close gate, but the docs present it as unconditional
The precheck accepts a referencing commit for the ticket OR any transitive descendant, not a single commit
AGENTS.md does not document rebar transition --ref, which enables closing a stacked story against its own commit without moving the worktree
The land-before-close ordering rule is the Verified +1 policy, not the precheck mechanism itself
The rewritten docs must preserve the warning against fast-forwarding the shared main checkout verbatim
